FIELDS.NAME: Shutter & Lens Photography Studio
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Shutter & Lens Photography Studio, we specialize in providing high-quality photography services, including portrait, event, commercial, and product photography. Our operations are carried out in a dedicated studio space located in a safe urban area, ensuring a professional environment for both our clients and staff. We utilize standard studio equipment and adhere to all local business, zoning, and health and safety regulations to maintain a safe and compliant operation. We pride ourselves on our structured client booking and project management process, alongside strong vendor relationships for our equipment and supply needs. Additionally, we offer ancillary services, such as makeup and hairstyling, which remain secondary to our core photography offerings. Our primary focus is on delivering exceptional photographic experiences while ensuring we operate within acceptable risk management guidelines.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2023, a water leak from a nearby apartment resulted in damage to studio equipment and props valued at $2,000. The claim was submitted and is currently under review. On 07/10/2023, a lighting equipment failure during a shoot caused an additional $1,200 in equipment repairs. This incident is resolved, and repairs were completed on 07/20/2023.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard commercial safe, Class B, UL rated.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with regular monitoring, secured fencing around premises, and on-site watchperson during business hours.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost, actual cost value of $450,000.00.
